title: Twist in double-murder suicide: Wife’s Rs 1.5 crore demand may have led to killings
content: A banker allegedly murdered his wife and sister in a double murder-suicide incident.  Divya Mishra sought a Rs 1.5 crore financial settlement in her divorce proceedings.  Strained relations over Manas Bajpayi's sister, Sheeba, also contributed to the marital discord.  Police are investigating the killings as a pre-planned sequence of events.  Digital evidence and witness statements are being analyzed to establish the motive.

title: Hockey World Cup: India's semifinal hopes end after 1-3 loss to Netherlands
content: The defeat leaves India without a point in the second round. India had already lost to England in the first round, and even a victory against Argentina on Monday would take them to only three points. That will not be enough to reach the semifinals. India will instead play in the fifth-eighth place classification matches after their final second-round game against Argentina.

title: Zohran Mamdani’s office skips City Council meeting on ‘second home tax’
content: The finance commissioner of New York City missed a crucial city council hearing regarding the pied-à-terre tax due to ongoing litigation, opting instead to provide written statements. The release of property valuations raised concerns about privacy and clarity among residents. In response, council members are actively pursuing answers and have prepared a list of inquiries for the administration.

title: FSSAI issued 150 notices to major food brands in recent months over misleading ads
content: India's food regulator FSSAI has issued over 150 notices to major food companies recently. These notices address misleading advertisements and non-compliance with labeling regulations. Action has been taken against brands like Nestle India and Coca-Cola India. E-commerce platforms Amazon and Flipkart also received multiple notices and a warehouse license cancellation. Food service establishments including KFC and McDonald's faced similar enforcement actions.

title: Being queer in Kashmir: Families, phones, friendships monitored, says report
content: A comprehensive report reveals the extensive control exerted over LGBTQIA+ individuals in Kashmir, highlighting issues such as monitored communications and scrutinized social interactions. The study emphasizes how family pressures and societal expectations surrounding marriage exacerbate marginalization. Additionally, educational institutions contribute to feelings of harassment and social exclusion. While some visibility fosters a degree of acceptance, it simultaneously increases the risk of backlash and surveillance for queer communities in the region.

title: 'Women are liable to no one': Rahul attacks 'Manusmriti' at Pune event
content: During a dynamic gathering in Pune, Rahul Gandhi championed women's independence and personal identity. However, discord erupted between student groups, necessitating police intervention and resulting in multiple arrests. Political factions exchanged blame over allegations of disrupted activities and financial support. The primary focus of the event was to confront significant student challenges, such as job scarcity and examination irregularities, against the backdrop of rising political tension related to youth agendas.

title: Most firms that laid off staff due to AI in America seemingly have a new slogan
content: Corporate executives are adopting a more measured tone about the role of AI in the job market. Investors are seeking evidence that AI investments are enhancing profit margins. As job losses become more frequent, public concerns escalate, with many Americans fearing that AI will diminish economic prospects. In response, companies are now positioning workforce adjustments as a transformation of roles rather than outright job elimination.

title: Kuldeep or Saransh? The subplot thickens as Colombo braces for a different script
content: Kuldeep Yadav's absence from India's final training sessions has intensified the selection intrigue ahead of the Colombo Test, with Saransh Jain's strong showing in the nets and Sri Lanka's left-hand-heavy batting line-up adding weight to the off-spinner's case. The second Test between India and Sri Lanka will start from Sunday at the Sinhalese Sports Club ground in Colombo.

title: 1,200 Starlink satellites help map Earth's hard-to-observe upper atmosphere
content: Starlink satellites are now helping scientists map Earth's upper atmosphere. Researchers used orbital data from Starlink to estimate thermosphere density. This method creates a two-dimensional map of atmospheric density variations. The findings offer a new way to study this difficult-to-observe region. Commercial satellite data is becoming an unexpected scientific resource.

title: Why Rockefeller secretly bought 35,000 acres, then donated them
content: In 1927, John D. Rockefeller Jr. quietly began buying large areas of land in Wyoming’s Jackson Hole through the Snake River Land Company. The company concealed Rockefeller’s involvement and eventually acquired more than 35,000 acres for $1.4 million. The land was later donated to the US government and became part of Grand Teton National Park.

title: Meta sued by former manager who claims he was fired over immigration letter
content: A former Meta manager filed a lawsuit alleging wrongful termination after objecting to an immigration letter. James Tillinghast claimed the letter overstated an employee's contributions and responsibilities. He also alleged Meta provided preferential immigration support to certain Chinese national employees. Tillinghast believes his dismissal was retaliation for raising these concerns. The lawsuit names Meta Platforms and a manager as defendants.

title: K'taka assembly passes apartment Bill: From ownership to redevelopment, rules defined
content: The Karnataka Assembly has passed a landmark bill to regulate apartment ownership and management effectively. This legislation lays the groundwork for Residents' Welfare Associations and offers guidance on managing common spaces. It also introduces a multi-tiered dispute resolution system. For redevelopment initiatives, a majority of 75% owner consent is now required, with owners who decline receiving double their property's assessed value.

title: Travis Kelce reveals why he sought professional help after life changed overnight
content: Travis Kelce might be one of the most popula athletes in the world but he had to seek professional help which had changed his life overnight.

title: Who is Sara Bejlek? 20-year-old stuns Sabalenka in Cincinnati Open run

Bejlek's impressive performance propelled her to a new career-high ranking. This success follows her earlier WTA singles title win in Abu Dhabi. The young Czech player is now a notable name in women's tennis.

Despite their semi-final loss to China's Liu Sheng Shu and Tan Ning, Gopichand praised the duo's progress and expressed optimism for India's Asian Games campaign.

title: FIR against Dipke: CJP founder booked for 'entering school without permission'

Further investigation into the incident is currently underway by officials.

title: ‘Crushed his lungs’: How a ‘minor’ dispute ended in Adobe techie's death

The assault occurred at his home in Delhi after his wife summoned her family members.  Police have detained four individuals in connection with the brutal incident and are investigating.  The case is being registered under sections relating to murder and common intention.

title: Amrit Bharat 3.0: AC coaches with Vande Bharat-style features for common man soon
content: Introduced in 2023, over 60-plus Amrit Bharat trains run across the Indian Railways network. The fares are around Rs 500 per 1,000 kilometres for sleeper class travel - the aim clearly being affordability.

title: IIT Delhi student dies after jumping from sixth-floor campus building
content: A 31-year-old M.Sc. Physics student at IIT Delhi died Saturday morning. Police received a call about a student jumping from a building on campus. The injured student was taken to the hospital and declared brought dead. Investigators found no apparent injuries other than those from the fall. Police are examining the student's mobile phone and counselling records.

title: 'Sometimes dynastic politics has its benefits': Akhilesh on how 5 family MPs helped SP

"Have you ever wondered why the entire party did not split? Because there are five MPs from the same family. We also have several Muslim MPs, and some staunch socialists, so our numbers would not decrease," he said.

title: MP: One newborn dies, 2 suffer burn injuries after warmer machine catches fire
content: A newborn died and two others were injured after a warmer machine caught fire in Chhindwara's NICU. The incident occurred early Saturday morning due to sparks from the machine's filament. Hospital staff quickly extinguished the blaze using firefighting equipment. The injured babies were transferred to Jabalpur for advanced medical care. An inquiry has been initiated to determine the exact cause of the fire.

title: After Root, Stokes calls ECB decision 'shambolic' over Headingley’s exclusion

This controversial move has sparked backlash among players and fans due to the historical importance these venues hold within Ashes cricket.

title: 7-storey under construction building collapses in Hyderabad, 2 dead

Search and rescue teams are actively working to locate any individuals who may be trapped beneath the rubble. Officials have sadly confirmed the death of at least two individuals due to the collapse. The building was reportedly erected on a cramped lot, and construction had previously ceased.

title: Mumbai hit-and-run: US national, 15, knocked down by speeding biker

She sustained a concussion, leg bruises, and a jaw injury from the collision. Police have registered a case and are actively searching for the fleeing motorcyclist. Activists noted the absence of speedbreakers due to Metro construction work.

title: Congress’s renewed youth outreach: How CJP has forced parties to course correct

The Congress party is now focusing on youth issues and expanding its outreach programs nationwide. Rahul Gandhi's recent actions highlight the party's renewed commitment to addressing student concerns. The Congress Working Committee has proposed an education-to-employment roadmap for young people. This shift reflects a broader effort to regain support among the nation's youth.

title: 'Don't be desperate for wickets': Gautam Gambhir's message to Kuldeep Yadav

India will be pleased with most aspects of their performance in Galle, but Kuldeep's form remains one of the major talking points.

title: Revanth Reddy not first CM to be denied MEA nod for foreign visit

Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann and West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee also experienced similar rejections.  Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal and Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan were also denied foreign trip approvals. title: Panama-flagged cargo ship carrying 24 on board sinks off Odisha coast
content:
The ship went down around 240 nautical miles off the Paradip coast (Representative image)

A Panama-flagged cargo vessel carrying iron ore from Odisha to Singapore sank in the Bay of Bengal on Saturday, officials told news agency PTI. The ship went down around 240 nautical miles off the Paradip coast with 24 crew members on board. Most of the crew were reportedly Chinese. The Indian Coast Guard and Indian Navy have launched a rescue operation, while other vessels in the area have been alerted to assist. “We are not sure how many of the crew members have been rescued,” a senior IPS officer told PTI.This is a developing story.
